auto_clarifications: Use live OperationsConsoleService, dependency health, reliability/runtime/provider/channel/skill/usage repositories, and computed system state; persisted snapshots are optional evidence, never fallback fixture rows.

Tenant admins see tenant-scoped run, delivery, usage, reliability, export, and safe log evidence only; platform-only database, provider, worker, queue, and storage pressure renders hidden or unavailable.
Default to the last 60 minutes, seed qa057 evidence inside that window, and allow only bounded presets backed by bounded queries.
Resolve requested run IDs from authorized runtime and audit-debug records; missing runs return not found, unauthorized runs fail closed, and no deterministic fallback run is rendered.
Derive likely causes deterministically from live symptoms and persist exports with safe storage metadata; UI artifact references must not expose storage URLs or local paths.
